cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two biscuits missing. Please don't refill the tin until I've established the weakness in our stock controls.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ate them. That's the mystery solved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The eater is not the weakness. Who issued you two biscuits without recording the withdrawal?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. I was hungry and the tin was open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Uncontrolled access and no meal provision. Write both down, separately. Apparently I'm auditing the whole break room before I can have a biscuit.

reason: Make each mundane detail widen A supposedly professional audit, giving B concrete recordkeeping rather than unsupported conspiracy slogans.
